About this app
This app is only an installer. The Menu Tweaks it installs is the work of its original authors and is not claimed by this app\'s creators (see Credits); this includes the original Portuguese menu. The tweak files bundled in the app and their accompanying scripts belong to their original authors, and these terms do not cover them. These terms cover the installer app, its source code, and the Arabic menu translation made by Yemeni.
Using the installer
It is strictly prohibited to patch a mod with this installer and then publish or share it with a statement such as “Patched by [Name]” or “Modified by [Name]” in a way that suggests you did the work by hand, when it was actually done with this app.
When you publish a mod (in a video or as a download link) that was patched using this installer, you must do one of the following:
1. Credit the installer or one of its creators (Yemeni or Scorpion). You may also write your own name, as long as the installer is credited with it, for example “Patched by [Name] using Yemeni\'s installer”.
2. Mention no names at all: not yours and not anyone else\'s. This is allowed because you are not claiming the work for yourself or for anyone else.
Mods with the Arabic menu
If your mod contains the Arabic menu installed by this app, option 2 does not apply: you must credit the installer or its creators (Yemeni or Scorpion).
The English menu may be used freely, with no credit required. The Portuguese menu belongs to the original authors.
Example of an allowed description: “[Mod Name] with the RE4 Menu Tweaks installed.” It states what was done without claiming ownership of the work.
Disclaimer
This app does not encourage piracy and does not distribute any game files. You must obtain the game yourself, legally. What anyone does with a mod edited by this app, including publishing a game image that contains it, is their own responsibility, and the creators of this app have no part in it. This does not change the credit rules above.
Source code and translations
You may not download the source code and replace the name Yemeni with your own, or remove the creators\' names, in order to claim the app or its development as your own. Modified versions are fine as long as the original names stay and the version is clearly marked, for example “Modified version by [Name]”.
The Arabic menu translation and the Arabic text tools in this project are Yemeni\'s work. If you reuse them in your own project, keep his credit.
The app is open source to help developers and modders: to study how it works, learn from its code, and contribute to its development. It is not meant for taking credit for someone else\'s work.
Agreement
By using this app, you confirm that you have read and agree to these terms.
